newsitem.title: USA: Premier Laser responds to FDA queries.
newsitem.headline: Premier Laser responds to FDA queries.

text.p: Premier Laser Systems Inc on Thursday said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration sent to the company a letter with a brief list of questions about its submission for approval of its Erbium:YAG laser systems, and the company has responded.
A spokesman for the company said the FDA's questions were "nothing serious" and "purely mechanical."
The Erbium:YAG laser systems would be used in certain procedures in hard-tissue dentistry, if they are approved.
Premier Laser said the letter informed it the FDA considers its submittal has a very high priority.
